en-US.title: Bringing you a discount for the best retouching ID photo studio🔥
en-US.description:
Attention, Carons planning to take ID photos or profile photos!🔥

I got a discount at a studio known for its amazing value and retouching skills!

You can choose between ID photos or profile photos, and they even include passport-sized shots for free.

They said you just need to use the photos within May, so if you want to keep a record of your photos, book in advance!🫶🏻

📸 https://zvzo.xyz/ko/cowork/unit/CWU9dl20zEI/p/PA2aSuPcJoyCz

The booking period is from April 10th to May 31st, so they say there aren't many spots left.ㅠㅠ Hurry and grab a time slot that works for you!❤️‍🔥

*The background color is only navy, so I recommend it for cool tones rather than warm tones.

I think I would have looked prettier wearing a white top too.ㅠㅠ (White tops are not allowed for passport photos!)

I took an ID photo for my records, but I recommend checking out the sample work for profile photos!

If your schedule works out, I recommend Friday! After visiting several shops, I found that on Saturdays, especially at shops that host weddings, it gets really crowded and chaotic.🥲

The total time required is one hour!

I think it would be great to set aside a whole day to enjoy it like this: 2 hours for hair and makeup at the shop + 1 hour for the studio shoot + 30 minutes for playing alone in the photo booth.😘 (I recommend bringing a touch-up pouch just in case you don't like the results from the shop!)

snippet.title: VLOG | 30대 여성의 삶…고민★ 일상 브이로그 (결혼, 커리어, 재테크, 이사준비, 피부과 시술)
snippet.description:
#VLOG #브이로그 #일상브이로그
*이 영상은 필러미학 캠페인 위원회의 초청을 받아 다녀온 내용이 포함되어 있습니다. 

안농 카롱이들!
오랜만에 브이로그를 가져와봤는데요, 파워 집순이인 제가 요즘 일정들이 아주 많답니다ㅏ😇 친구들의 결혼, 집들이, 신년회 등등 좋은 소식들로 가득찬 한해를 맞으며 일상기록을 해보았어요.

snippet.title: 자취생 이사 필수 꿀팁 #무료인테리어하는법
snippet.description:
광고❌ 요즘 이사시즌인것 같은데 모르는 사람들 있을까봐 공유하는 #이사꿀팁 1★
저는 딱딱맞는 가구정렬에 진심인 사람이라 이사갈때마다 이걸로 미리 준비해보고 가는데요. 누구나 무료로 이용가능한 서비스입니다!

등록된 아파트같은 경우는 집 도면도 바로 불러오기 가능하고, 등록이 안되어있어도 슥슥 벽 만들고 창문달고 하다보면 손쉽게 집구조를 만들 수 있구요.
여기에 바닥, 마감재, 벽지 선택도 다양하고 등록되어있는 가구나 소품같은 것도 꽤 많아서 미리 나의 공간을 꾸며볼 수 있는건데요.
일인칭 시점 투어도 가능해서 동선따라 가구배치 시뮬레이션 해보기에도 좋아요!!!

저는 이미 이걸로 이사갈 집 구조 익히고 새로 들일 가구 후보군도 뽑아놨다는,,ㅎㅎ
대문자J 인간이라 이런 기능을 무료로 풀어주신것에 정말... 깊은 감사를 드리며 꿀정보 공유해봅니당🥹🫶🏻


🙋🏻‍♀️뷰티패션 정보가 아니지만,, 이렇게 종종 라이프꿀템&꿀팁들도 풀어보고 있는데 알고리즘이 꼬일라나요..ㅎ
반응없으면 그냥 혼자만 알고있을게,,,😇

en-US.description:
Advertisement❌ It seems like it's moving season these days, so I'm sharing #MovingTip1★ just in case anyone doesn't know.
I'm a sucker for perfect furniture arrangements, so I use this to prepare in advance every time I move. It's a free service available to anyone!

For registered apartments, you can immediately upload the floor plan. Even if you're not registered, you can easily build a house by quickly building walls and installing windows.
There are also a variety of flooring, finishing materials, and wallpaper options, and there are plenty of registered furniture and accessories, so you can decorate your space in advance.
You can also use the first-person tour, which is great for simulating furniture arrangements along your moving route!

I've already used this to familiarize myself with the layout of my new home and even selected furniture candidates, haha.
As a capital J human, I'm truly grateful that you've made this feature available for free. I'm sharing this valuable information with you. 🥹🫶🏻
